Alex / Marissa —

Thanks for the notes. Short answers up front, details below. Attaching a short SOC 2 draft summary for context (SOC2-Draft-2026Q3-summary.pdf).

1) SOC 2: Redwood is currently undergoing a Type II audit; we expect report completion in Q3 2026. We can provide the SOC 2 Type I report and interim control evidence today, and will provide the Type II report upon issuance.

2) GDPR / HIPAA: Redwood supports data subject requests and can sign a BAA for HIPAA-scoped engagements. For GDPR we provide standard Data Processing Addenda and data access controls.

3) Data deletion vs backups: 
   - Customer-facing data deletion (primary customer content and customer-controlled metadata): our standard SLA is deletion of active copies within 30 days of request/termination.
   - Backups: system backups are retained for 90 days by default to support incident recovery. Backups are immutable for the retention window and are overwritten/rotated after the retention period.
   - Extended log retention: for customers requiring >90 days (e.g., 3 years of audit logs) we offer custom retention policies under enterprise plans — this is stored in hardened, access-restricted buckets and billed as additional storage.

4) Logs and audit trail types:
   - Application/customer activity logs: configurable retention; treated as customer-controlled telemetry when requested.
   - Authentication & admin audit logs: we retain as needed for security investigations and for enterprise SLAs; by default these follow the 90-day retention policy but can be extended for specific accounts.

5) Deletion semantics: when we say "deletion" we mean removal of primary and indexed copies such that normal product APIs cannot access the data. Forensically, remnants may exist in backups until the backup retention window expires (standard: 90 days unless extended). We can negotiate shorter backup windows but that affects restore guarantees and pricing.

Next steps I recommend:
- Marissa: we can take point on the vendor questionnaire and route any SOC 2 or infra questions to me and Rishi.
- Alex / Amaya: please flag any questions in the worksheet you attached; we'll mark those that require legal/infosec review.

Attachments: SOC2-Draft-2026Q3-summary.pdf

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
